raw_evidence: /mnt/project-files/evals-cache/f15/ (ref/ reference outputs, captures and network logs; out/ our outputs; scripts/). Not in git.
harness: Playwright headless Chromium, 1280x632; 390x664 by resizing the same session. Tilt measured by a projection-profile search on a 144 dpi render (checked on the source: 3.0, -1.5, 0.0, 0.6) and from the turn matrix written at the head of each page's content.

input.pages: 4 pages of real text, 420x594, tilted +3.0, -1.5, 0.0, +0.6 degrees (clockwise positive)

flow: Choosing the file uploads it at once (POST /api/files/upload). No page is shown.
Step 1, 'Choose an option': Automatic (preselected) or Manually page by page, then Continue.
Automatic, step 2: an 'Only specific pages' range field (optional, e.g. 1-10,13) and an 'Only straighten strongly skewed pages' tick, off by default; then the run button.

Manual: one page at a time on a canvas with dashed guide lines, Previous / Next and a page number box, a rotation slider and six step buttons (-1, -0.5, -0.1, +0.1, +0.5, +1 degrees). Every page starts at 0.0; nothing is detected for you in this mode. The run button sits below the fold at 1280x632 (y=800) and at 390.
No detected angle is shown anywhere before the run; automatic and manual cannot be mixed in one run.
Result opens in an overlay frame: Download, save to cloud, share, Back to editing, Start over, Delete files.
Stated free limits: 200 pages or 100 MB, 3 tasks per hour.

task1.settings: Automatic, defaults (no page range, strong-skew-only off)

task2.settings: Automatic, same settings as task 1 (the tick was already off, so this did not test strong-skew-only on). Run for an exact end-to-end time: every button clicked the moment it appeared, 25 ms polling inside the result frame.

output_observations: Both outputs render identically, pixel for pixel.
Measured tilt after: 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0. Turn applied per the page matrices: 3.011, 1.484, none, 0.600 degrees, so what is left is 0.011, 0.016, 0, 0.000 degrees.
Page 3 (straight) content is byte-identical to the source.
Text is still text: 27 text objects per page, extracted words identical to the source on all 4 pages. Page size unchanged, no ink at the page edge, qpdf check clean.
reference.phone_390: No sideways scroll on any step. Options and run button in view on the automatic path; result Download at y=244. Manual mode: page, Previous/Next and slider in view, step buttons and run button below the fold.
reference.not_captured: Strong-skew-only switched on; a page-range run; a manual-mode run; error states; a scanned (image-only) file. No task budget left. A re-check of our side needs no new reference tasks.
